blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Sunday highlighted more than 100 outcomes and 19 priority economic deliverables under the Philippines’ chairmanship of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) in 2026. “Their breadth reflects the collective effort invested throughout the year and the continuity of an Asean agenda that each year carries forward under Asean 2045: Our Shared Future,” Marcos said. “For the Philippines, this is not simply a vision of where we hope to be two decades from now.
